name: effect-web-workspace
description: Workspace for the @thomasfosterau/effect-web package family: framework-neutral web utilities, the Cloudflare Workers / Alchemy runtime scaffold, a PostHog prototype, and robots.txt / sitemap / feed builders, extracted from the website, gardeneria and preferenceflow applications.
author: Thomas Foster <me@thomasfoster.au>

scripts.version: changeset version && vp fmt && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: vp run -r build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --access public --no-git-checks && changeset tag
